title: She Got Wasted at the Airport Bar After Her Flight Was Canceled
description:
A woman learns airports aren’t for partying after her flight got canceled and instead of going home, she decides to pound shots and drink beers at the airport bar. Fellow travelers called for assistance after realizing she couldn’t stand. When police arrived, the woman, who claimed to be “Britney Spears,” wasn’t ready for the party to end.

From high-speed chases to DUI arrests, Law&Crime BodyCam delivers the most shocking police encounters straight from the source. Subscribe now and catch the action: @lawandcrimebodycam 

#Bodycam #Airport #LawAndCrime
